newsitem.title: USA: Dart files two suits against chairman.
newsitem.headline: Dart files two suits against chairman.

text.p: Dart Group Corp said Tuesday it filed two suits against Herbert Haft, the company's chairman and chief executive officer, seeking in one suit about $43 million in damages for Robert Haft's firing in 1993.
Dart also said it was seeking unspecified damages from Herbert Haft in the second suit, filed in Maryland, related to a series of real estate and equipment lease transactions.
The suits were filed by Dart, Crown Books Corp, and Trak Auto Corp, the company said.

The federal suit seeking $43 million related to Herbert Haft's firing of Robert Haft from his executive positions in 1993. Earlier this year, Dart and Crown paid about $38 million to Robert Haft after their appeals to the U.S. Court of Appeals were denied, Dart said.
Dart and Crown also paid about $5.2 legal fees related to the matter.

The company said the suit filed in Maryland was in addition to a suit Dart filed last year against Haft and others about certain real estate transactions. The earlier suit was sought more than $80 million, it said.
